plugin.name: Routing Plan
plugin.description: Turn-by-turn navigation plugin using Valhalla routing engine. Load waypoints from CSV/XLSX/GeoJSON/KML, compute routes with 8 costing modes, export to HTML/GeoJSON/KML/GeoPackage.
plugin.about: QGIS plugin for turn-by-turn navigation using Valhalla. Personal & community project. Built for QGIS 4.0+.
plugin.author: Dhany Yudi Prasetyo
